zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 滚动长截图无缝回访
changes: 向上回看已捕获区域时不再重复写入，再次向下超过历史边界后无缝恢复拼接
双向位移匹配结合高分辨率复核，减少滚动换向与小幅回退造成的错位
历史关键帧可在掉帧或大跨度滚动后重新定位，重复内容无法唯一判断时会拒绝误拼
应用、Sparkle 更新 ZIP 和手动安装 DMG 均已签名并通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: Seamless scroll-capture revisits
changes: Scrolling back through captured content no longer adds duplicate rows, and stitching resumes seamlessly past the previous boundary.
Bidirectional motion matching with high-resolution verification reduces seams after direction changes and small reversals.
Historical keyframes recover position after dropped frames or large jumps, while ambiguous repeated content is rejected instead of mis-stitched.
The app, Sparkle update ZIP, and manual-install DMG are signed and notarized by Apple.
